jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.description: Small businesses represent 99.9% of all companies, yet they're still forced to choose between clunky, outdated enterprise phone systems or their personal phones. This multi-billion dollar market has been overlooked for decades, left to cobble together solutions that slow them down instead of helping them grow. Quo is changing that. We bring calls, texts, and customer information together into one easy-to-use, AI-powered platform. We're not just building a phone system. We're setting a new standard for how businesses connect with their customers. Driven by our values, we move fast, build with determination, and obsess over delivering value to the businesses that have been underserved for far too long. Today, Quo is trusted by more than 120,000 companies and rated #1 in customer satisfaction on G2. We're backed by Y Combinator, Tiger Global, Craft Ventures, Slow Ventures, and other top-tier investors. It's safe to say we're onto something big. ABOUT THE ROLE As a Senior Backend Engineer at Quo, you will spend a majority of your time coding, architecting, and owning moderate to complex components. Beyond your technical work, you may also lead a small team or a project. You might also spend time providing technical guidance, code reviews, and design and delivering on small/medium size projects end-to-end. POTENTIAL AREAS OF FOCUS INCLUDE: - Leveraging AI and advanced technologies to help customers manage and derive insights from their data, optimizing the customer onboarding experience. - Empowering users to independently set up, manage, and scale their accounts with a seamless and compliant process. - Enhancing core messaging and calling features, improving customer data management, and optimizing the visibility of conversations and contacts. In any of these areas, you’ll have the opportunity to tackle impactful challenges and help build scalable backend systems that will support a growing user base. TECHNICAL STACK AND TOOLS: - Our backend is built on Node using Typescript. - We use Kubernetes on AWS to orchestrate our infrastructure setup and deployment. - The overall architecture is event-driven microservices with Temporal and RabbitMQ at the center of it. - We use a variety of databases for different purposes: Postgres, Mongo, Elastic, and Redis. - Observability Tools: Datadog - Other Tools: Figma, Linear, Notion, and Slack ABOUT YOU - Strong experience with Typescript, or experience with object-oriented languages such as Java or C# and Javascript/Node. - Strong experience with observability tools, including metrics, structured logging and distributed tracing - You take ownership of your work and understand the importance of communication. You hold yourself to a high standard and help empower others to do the same. - You are intentional about how your work impacts customers, the community, and each other. You practice empathy, generosity, and thoughtfulness as you evaluate tradeoffs in pursuit of the best solution. - You are curious. You better seek to understand the ‘why’ behind things, so that you can better plan and build the ‘how’. You support your teammates and customers through the continuous pursuit of knowledge. You’re a lifelong learner. - Your code is a pleasure for your teammates to read and understand and you strive to ensure it is readable, testable, and maintainable.. When working in the codebase, you leave things better than you found them. - You embrace AI and find ways to use it to improve your work, rather than shying away from it. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Accounts, Billing, & Compliance
jobs.description: Small businesses represent 99.9% of all companies, yet they're still forced to choose between clunky, outdated enterprise phone systems or their personal phones. This multi-billion dollar market has been overlooked for decades, left to cobble together solutions that slow them down instead of helping them grow. Quo is changing that. We bring calls, texts, and customer information together into one easy-to-use, AI-powered platform. We're not just building a phone system. We're setting a new standard for how businesses connect with their customers. Driven by our values, we move fast, build with determination, and obsess over delivering value to the businesses that have been underserved for far too long. Today, Quo is trusted by more than 120,000 companies and rated #1 in customer satisfaction on G2. We're backed by Y Combinator, Tiger Global, Craft Ventures, Slow Ventures, and other top-tier investors. It's safe to say we're onto something big. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the surfaces that makes Quo trustworthy at scale — the systems that bill customers correctly, define who they are and what they can access, and keep their calls and messages complaint and deliverable. You will span three foundational domains: billing systems, accounts and identity, and telecom compliance. It’s a hands-on, high stakes and high impact role. The work rarely makes a splashy demo, but nearly every team at Quo depends on it, and when its wrong the consequences are financial, legal, or existential. You’ll partner directly with engineering, finance, security, legal, and compliance operations to build systems where correctness and trust matter more than anything. SOME OF THE THINGS YOU’LL DO: - Own our billing system: metering and usage tracking, entitlements, plan changes and proration, invoicing, payment processing, failed-payment recovery, and the data that feeds revenue reporting. - Translate pricing and packaging into system behaviour: work with the business to understand our monetization strategy, and figure out how the system actually represents and enforces it. - Own accounts and identity: the account lifecycle, authentication and SSO, user roles and permissions, and the admin controls customers expect. - Own telecom compliance: A2P 10DLC registration, carrier and aggregator relationships, messaging throughput and trust scores, fraud and platform-integrity tooling, and voice-side requirements like TCPA and robocall mitigation, treating compliance as a means to improve deliverability, an important growth lever for the business. - Build roadmaps across all three domains, balancing across multiple dimensions - Partner closely with engineering on system design, data models, and APIs ABOUT YOU - 5+ years in product management, including meaningful time on platform, infrastructure, or backend-facing products where you owned the underlying systems. - A track record of turning ambiguous, technically complex, cross-functional problems into shipped systems, and of writing crisp specs engineers trust. - Comfort operating in high-correctness domains and defending tradeoffs where the stakes are real. - Strong collaboration instincts with non-traditional PM stakeholders like finance, legal, security, and support, plus the judgment to navigate competing priorities among them. - The ability to ramp fast on regulated, technical domains. COMPENSATION The annual base salary range for this position in Canada is $166,000 - $196,000 CAD, plus equity and benefits. This range is designed to align with market rates in areas where we are actively recruiting across the US and Canada. The range displayed reflects the target for new hire salaries, and within this range, individual pay is determined by your skills and experience, as well as relevant education. jobs.title: Customer Service Agent (Remote, Tech Startup)
jobs.description: This job is what Jerry is all about: helping our customers take care of their most important assets, their car and home, with the kind of warmth and speed they didn't expect from an insurance company. Car and home are people’s most important assets, yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every part of the journey - insurance, repairs, financing, maintenance - is fragmented, complicated, and expensive. Jerry.ai http://Jerry.ai is building the first app to help people manage it all. The work is fast-paced, high-energy, team-oriented, and fully remote. A few things our team members love about working at Jerry: - Opportunities to shape the customer experience as the product and services are constantly evolving. - Competitive wage and benefits (medical, dental, vision insurance, 401K match, paid vacation time). - Stock equity (stock options) — we're a tech startup, and you own a piece of what you're building. - Flexible scheduling: a 5-day, 8-hour or a 4-day, 10-hour work week. - Fully remote, with work equipment provided. - A career path in one of the largest industries in the world — insurance. We pay for your P&C insurance license if you don’t have one yet. - And, importantly, the colleagues you work alongside. Ask our team what they value most and the answer is almost always the same: the people and the culture. Jerry is full of people who take their work seriously and take helping each other just as seriously. As a member in the Customer Operations team, some of your responsibilities could include: - Taking great care of our customers. Our team members don't just answer the question asked — they catch the thing the customer didn't know to ask about. A coverage gap. A discount they qualify for. A renewal about to spike. - Answering inbound calls from policyholders who need something changed. - Getting deep on the product. With a large panel of insurance companies to work from, knowing which one fits which customer is the craft of this job. Our app evolves constantly too, and knowing it inside out makes you the person customers trust to navigate it. - Problem solving to resolve customer inquiries effectively. - Processing service requests — vehicles, drivers, lienholders, policy documents. - Making the product better. Tell us what you're hearing. The feedback loop here is short enough that you'll see your suggestions ship. Who you are: - Prior work experience in customer service, sales, or hospitality is a plus, but not required - Genuinely friendly and positive attitude and willingness to work as a team - Strong work ethic - Strong problem solving skills - Strong communication skills Compensation and perks: - Hourly wage of $19.00 - 21.00 + equity (stock options) While we appreciate your interest and application, due to the volume of applications we receive, only applicants under consideration will be contacted. Please note: Jerry.ai http://Jerry.ai is only able to hire full-time salaried employees who currently reside in AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, MA, NC, NJ, NV, NY, OR, TN, TX, UT, VA, or Ontario, Canada, and full-time hourly employees who currently reside in AZ, FL, GA, NV, NY, NC, TN, TX, UT, or VA. jobs.description: Location: Remote-friendly (with offices in NYC, Amsterdam, and Paris) At Escape, we empower small security teams to break through headcount limits by transforming manual security work into scalable, streamlined workflows, from attack surface management and dynamic security testing to AI-driven pentesting. Our mission is to align security and engineering and make advanced application security accessible and impactful for innovative businesses worldwide. Having just raised our $18M Series A, our team of 30 passionate "Escapers" is breaking down barriers and rapidly bringing cybersecurity innovation from R&D to production. Every member of our fast-scaling team is empowered to take on meaningful responsibilities and create real impact. WHY JOIN ESCAPE? - Be part of a high-growth startup at a pivotal inflection point - Learn hands-on about cutting-edge applications in AI and cybersecurity - Collaborate with a world-class, international team across the US and Europe - Take ownership and contribute directly to our rapid growth - Grow with a product trusted by top-tier clients—including the Olympic Games, the French Football Federation, Miro, and PandaDoc YOUR ROLE As our first dedicated Product Marketing Manager (PMM), you’ll report directly to a founder and own how Escape is discovered, understood, and adopted by the security world. You will define Escape’s category position, crafting narrative and go-to-market strategies across both US and European markets. You Will: - Develop impactful product messaging for Security Leaders and Engineers, translating technical features into compelling, value-based stories - Own go-to-market strategies for new feature launches, collaborating closely with the Growth Marketing team to drive pipeline results - Lead market and competitive research, sharpening Escape’s positioning and informing product roadmap decisions - Drive thought leadership initiatives, including speaking engagements (e.g., partner webinars) and high-impact content - Build the sales enablement toolkit, designing pitch decks, battlecards, competitive comparisons, and one-pagers to ensure our commercial team excels - Establish foundational PMM processes, playbooks, and strategies to scale and evolve with the company YOUR IMPACT - Security teams instantly understand how Escape fits into their security stack, thanks to your clear and compelling messaging - Sales cycles accelerate as reps are empowered with sharp, resonant narratives and robust competitive positioning - Feature launches consistently generate traction and move the pipeline forward - Escape builds a recognized voice in offensive security, with you as a key architect of our thought leadership ABOUT YOU - 5+ years total experience, with at least 2 years in product marketing (ideally in cybersecurity, developer tools, or technical B2B SaaS at high-growth companies) - Demonstrated success in marketing to technical audiences, you understand engineers and speak their language - Experience supporting product launches end-to-end, from messaging and asset creation to performance analysis - Strong storytelling capabilities, able to distill technical topics into compelling, audience-adaptive narratives - Collaborative and cross-functional, comfortable working closely with engineering, product, and go-to-market teams Bonus Points: - Start-up experience, particularly in early-stage, fast-moving environments - jobs.title: Systems Engineer, Network Automation
jobs.description: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations: Lisbon, Portugal About the Department Cloudflare's Network Engineering Team builds and runs the infrastructure that runs our software. The Engineering Team is split into two groups: one handles product development and the other handles operations. Product development covers both new features and functionality and scaling our existing software to meet the challenges of a massively growing customer base. The operations team handles one of the world's largest networks with data centers in 190 cities worldwide and a couple of large specialized data centers for internal needs. About the role Cloudflare operates a large global network spanning hundreds of cities (data centers). You will join a team of talented network automation engineers who are building software solutions to improve network resilience and reduce engineering operational toil. You will work on a range of tools, infrastructure and services - new and existing - with an aim to elegantly and efficiently solve problems and deliver practical, maintainable and scalable solutions. Leverage AI tools and automated assistants to streamline daily workflows. Examples Of Desirable Skills, Knowledge And Experience BA/BS in Computer Science or equivalent experience 3+ years of proven experience in developing software components for network automation. Understanding of software development principles, design patterns, and various programming languages (like python and golang) Proficient with modern Unix/Linux operating systems/distributions Experience in MySQL, Postgres, Clickhouse (or equivalent SQL language) Experience with CI/CD, containers and/or virtualization Experience with Observability systems like prometheus, grafana (or equivalents) Demonstrated experience working alongside AI assistants or automated tools to augment task execution and project delivery Bonus Points: Knowledge of Networking engineering, with competencies in Layer 2 and Layer 3 protocols and vendor equipment: Cisco, Juniper, etc. Experience building and maintaining large distributed systems Experience managing internal and/or external customer requirements and expectations Compensation Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location. For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary of €54,000 - €75,000 Equity This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan. jobs.description: Manager, PLG & Agent-led Growth People no longer have to learn complex systems anymore. They ask Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and then let them set it up for them. Supabase says over 60% of its new databases are launched by AI tools, and agent-created databases at Neon are at 80%. SingleStore is still built for a person clicking through our portal. AI & Agents do not reach for us often enough, and when they do, they struggle to sign up, load data, and get to a working query without a human. That is the problem this role exists to solve. You will own product-led growth and agent-led growth at SingleStore. That means making SingleStore the database that AI answer engines recommend, that agents pick, and that agents and people can get running on their own data in minutes. You will also turn that usage into revenue through data & product-led sales. You will report to our VP of Growth, work closely with our Chief Marketing Officer and product team, and have visibility into the CEO. jobs.title: Senior Detection Engineer | SecOps
jobs.description: WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR You'll own detection engineering and help shape how ARQ detects and responds to threats. From bringing new log sources into ARQ’s SIEM to writing, testing and tuning detections, you'll be responsible for making sure our coverage works when it matters. We're looking for someone who combines hands-on detection experience with an engineering mindset. You'll work directly with our CISO and a small global security team, with the autonomy to prioritise gaps and build practical solutions. Automation is central to how we work: you'll build and run AI agents that support rule development, validation, alert triage and threat hunting, with you reviewing and approving their output. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Own detection engineering end to end in Datadog Cloud SIEM: identify missing log sources, prioritise onboarding and build reliable detection coverage. - Write, test and tune detection rules, reducing false positives while keeping meaningful threats visible. - Map coverage to MITRE ATT&CK and validate it by reproducing attacker activity. - Manage detections as code, using version control, CI pipelines and code review. - Build and run automation and AI agents for rule authoring, detection validation, coverage mapping, alert triage and threat hunting. - Investigate security incidents, including triage, scoping, evidence collection and clear incident write-ups. - Help develop automated response and containment capabilities. - Track and communicate detection coverage, validation results and response performance to security leadership. WHAT YOU'LL NEED - 5+ years in security, including 3+ years writing and owning detections in production. - Hands-on experience with a cloud SIEM and its query language, such as Datadog Cloud SIEM, Splunk, Elastic, Google SecOps. - Deep knowledge of AWS logs, particularly CloudTrail, IAM and IAM Identity Center, alongside experience with SaaS audit logs such as Google Workspace, GitHub, GitLab or Okta. - Experience managing detections as code using Terraform, Git, CI pipelines and code review. - Practical experience mapping detections to MITRE ATT&CK and testing rules by reproducing attacks with tools such as Atomic Red Team or Stratus Red Team. - Python skills for automation, log analysis and security tooling, with a record of shipping automation or AI agents that others use. - Hands-on incident response experience, from investigating alerts to documenting findings and remediation. - The ability to work independently, prioritise effectively and own outcomes in a small team without a dedicated SOC behind you. - Strong written and verbal communication in English. NICE TO HAVE - Familiarity with CrowdStrike Falcon, Datadog SIEM, Cloudflare Zero Trust or WAF. - Experience working with Kubernetes (EKS) audit logs. - Threat hunting, red team or purple team experience. - Experience building agentic workflows using Claude or OpenAI. - A background in fintech, payments or crypto, with exposure to SOC 2 or PCI DSS. - Spanish or Portuguese language skills. BENEFITS - Competitive salary and benefits - Stock options, so you own part of what you build - Discretionary performance bonus - The latest tools and technology - A world-class team that will challenge and grow your skills - The opportunity to help build the best fintech app in Latin America - Office Policy: 3-4 days a week in-office

WHAT YOU'LL NEED - 5+ years in information security GRC, IT audit or cyber risk, including at least 2 years in financial services. - Experience owning evidence collection and coordinating control owners through a SOC 2 or ISO 27001 audit, alongside working knowledge of PCI DSS. - A practical understanding of GDPR, including lawful basis, data processing agreements, international transfers and breach notification. - Experience running vendor security reviews and interpreting SOC 2 reports, including exceptions and complementary user entity controls. - The ability to write clear policies and procedures and turn control requirements into practical actions for engineers. - Experience working directly with auditors or regulators and managing findings through to closure. - Spanish fluency sufficient to lead discussions with regulators and auditors, alongside professional English for working with a global team. - The autonomy to manage priorities and drive programmes forward while working with colleagues across countries and time zones. - Based in Colombia, preferably Bogotá, with the right to work there. NICE TO HAVE - Experience within an SFC-supervised entity or a fintech undergoing SFC licensing. - Exposure to other LatAm regulators, such as CNBV, BCRA or BCB. - Experience implementing ISO 27001 or supporting PCI DSS assessments. - Familiarity with GRC platforms such as Vanta, Drata or OneTrust. - Enough AWS and cloud security knowledge to assess engineering evidence and challenge gaps. - Experience automating GRC workflows. - Portuguese language skills. Agree success measures and continuing ownership with partner teams. WHAT YOU'LL BRING - Demonstrated engineering management. You have led and developed engineers, made prioritization and performance decisions, hired thoughtfully, and delivered through a team—not only acted as its strongest individual contributor. - Software-oriented production systems depth. You have built and operated distributed systems or reliability platforms and can reason across deployment behavior, Kubernetes, telemetry, service dependencies, and recovery mechanisms. - Safe-change and performance judgment. You have led consequential migrations or incidents and used measurement to diagnose reliability or performance problems. You can distinguish symptoms from causes and validate fixes under realistic conditions. - Platform-product and cross-team judgment. You can build capabilities other teams adopt, lead hands-on engagements without absorbing every service's operations, and make clear tradeoffs among reliability, performance, engineering effort, and cost. You won’t just train models in isolation; you will build end-to-end pipelines that extract signals, train custom models per merchant, and serve predictions at production scale with low latency. This role combines elements of a solutions architect, technical account manager, and solution engineer, with a strong emphasis on execution. As an FDE, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor and sounding board for customers, helping them design, implement, and scale real-time data solutions using SingleStore. You will work closely with customers to understand their business objectives, translate them into technical strategies, and drive those solutions into production. Design and implement end-to-end solutions integrating SingleStore into existing application and data ecosystems. Experience integrating complex systems across data pipelines, applications, and infrastructure. Ability to translate ambiguous requirements into clear technical plans and drive execution. Experience working with enterprise customers, particularly in financial services or high-tech environments, is highly preferred. Strong communication and organizational skills, with the ability to guide both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Demonstrated ability to balance technical innovation with pragmatic delivery and realistic scoping. Alignment with product capabilities and roadmap, ensuring solutions are both impactful and feasible. jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Manager
jobs.description: At Parallel, we build AI agents that help healthcare organizations automate their administrative processes and unlock additional revenue, starting with medical coding. Today, up to 25% of healthcare spending is lost to manual, repetitive administrative tasks. Legacy software hasn't helped: it has made work slower, more complex and more frustrating for care teams. We believe AI agents can change this. Our technology combines large language models with system-level automation to do real work inside existing hospital tools. No integration, no disruption. Our first agent automates coding and frees up time for medical teams to focus on patients. We launched in 2024 and already have 800+ customers and a team of 30+ people. We are backed by top-tier investors (Index Ventures, Y Combinator, Hexa, Frst, Kima Ventures, Better Angle and the CEO of Mistral AI), and this is just the beginning. The future of healthcare isn't just digital, it's automated. Come help us build it! THE ROLE CONTEXT This role is open to support an ambitious hiring goal: growing the team by 50%. You will join a team of three recruiters, alongside Léa, our Talent Lead, with whom you will work hand in hand. The priority of the role is hiring tech profiles: Senior Fullstack Engineers, Forward Deployed Engineers and AI Engineers. MISSIONS Hire the best tech talent - Gather hiring needs with Hiring Managers, co-build scorecards, then write and publish job offers. - Source active and passive candidates through multiple channels, with a strong focus on headhunting (LinkedIn Recruiter, referrals, events). - Assess candidates and run hiring processes end to end in Ashby, through to the offer. - Ensure a high-quality candidate experience at every step. Support Hiring Managers - Be their point of contact and help them define their team strategy through hiring. Contribute to the recruiting team - Contribute, alongside Léa, to improving our hiring processes and our employer brand. In your first months, you will have made your first hires and improved time to offer through your continuous improvement proposals. WHO YOU ARE - You have 2 to 4 years of recruiting experience. - You have solid sourcing experience, especially for tech profiles, ideally gained at a SaaS company with a strong technical component. - In-house recruiting experience is a plus. - You have a sales mindset and the drive to win. - You are very rigorous, including in writing. - Ideally, you have a good level of English. OUR VALUES - Play to Win: we're not here to just take part, deliver something "good enough" or simply enjoy the startup ride. We want to win. That means caring about results, moving fast and bringing the right intensity when it matters. - High Trust, High Standards: trust is our starting point. If you join us, it's because we believe you can own your scope and make good decisions. We don't want a company built on approvals, control and micromanagement. But trust comes with accountability: the more freedom you have, the higher the bar. - Low Ego, Hands-On: at Parallel, no one is above the work. No title, seniority or past success exempts anyone from getting involved in the actual work. Leading means taking responsibility, not distancing yourself from execution. - Don't Take Yourself Too Seriously: we take our mission very seriously, not ourselves. Building a company is intense. We want Parallel to remain a place where people enjoy spending time together, laughing, celebrating and giving energy to others. High standards and a good atmosphere aren't opposites: we want both. HIRING PROCESS 1. Call with Léa, Talent Lead (30 min) 2. Interviews at our Paris office with Chris and Paul, the founders (2 hours) 3. Reference checks WHY JOIN US? - Real impact: every hire directly contributes to Parallel's growth. - A structuring role: you help build our hiring processes and employer brand. - Real traction: seed and Series A ($20M with Index Ventures) closed in less than a year, 800+ customers and a team of 3

jobs.description: About us We’re a fast-growing fintech on a mission to redefine how Latin America manages its finances and this is your opportunity to be a crucial part of that transformation. Join a team of top talent from the world’s leading fintech and tech companies, and help build a cross-border financial system that’s modern, accessible, and built to scale. Who we’re looking for We are looking for a Chief Compliance Officer to lead ARQ’s US investment compliance functions, serve as CCO for our SEC-registered investment adviser, and act as the proposed CCO for our introducing broker-dealer through its FINRA New Member Application (NMA) and launch. You will bring prior CCO experience across both SEC-registered RIAs and FINRA broker-dealers, with a strong understanding of digital investment platforms and clearing broker relationships. This is a hands-on role. You will oversee the RIA’s compliance program, help lead the broker-dealer application, and build the supervisory framework for launch. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, Legal, the BSA/AML Officer, and the outsourced FINOP to embed effective controls in ARQ’s investment offering. What you’ll do: 1. RIA program ownership: Administer the RIA’s compliance policies, risk assessment, monitoring, testing, and documented annual review. Broker dealer supervision: Build and lead the compliance and supervisory framework for a fully disclosed introducing broker offering self-directed trading. Establish assigned supervisory responsibilities, account and transaction reviews, supervisory testing, escalation processes, and required annual reporting. 4. Digital investment advice: Oversee compliance controls for automated, non-discretionary recommendations, including client questionnaires, risk profiles, portfolio methodology, algorithm testing, change management, and ongoing monitoring. Records and customer protection: Maintain compliant books and records, communications retention, privacy and safeguarding controls, and complaint handling. Examinations and coordination: Lead SEC and FINRA examinations and inquiries, coordinate audits and remediation, and train employees. Our customers love the product because it works: high accuracy, fast deployment, and an operator-friendly experience that makes real factory rollouts possible, not just pilots. WHY THIS ROLE IS EXCITING - Build, not maintain: You set up the entities, policies, and processes a growing China operation runs on. - Breadth: Cross-office scope across three locations, spanning HR, global mobility, facilities, and workspace projects. - Global exposure: You work daily with international colleagues across a company deploying in factories worldwide. - Ownership: You are the go-to person for how the China offices run. WHAT YOU’LL OWN - Entity setup: Own HR setup for new China entities, including registration support, employment structure, and local compliance. - Onboarding and global mobility: Employment documents, onboarding and orientation, work permits, visas, relocation, and cross-office transfers. - Employee records: Personnel files, contracts, attendance, and leave records, kept accurate and current. - Payroll coordination: Compile and verify attendance, overtime, and leave data for timely, accurate salary processing. - HR policy: Implement, communicate, and update policies, procedures, and employee guidelines. - Employee relations and engagement: First point of contact for employee questions and workplace concerns; organize team-building. - Office, facilities, and workspace: Maintenance, equipment, assets, and admin expenses across Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Hong Kong, plus office relocation and renovation projects. - Travel and business tools: Administer Ctrip Business and Didi Business, including access, usage monitoring, vendor coordination, and cost tracking. Why we exist: Your car, home, and motorcycle aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every step of the journey — buying, insuring, maintaining, repairing, selling — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive. Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. That friend is Jerry. We are building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets. We started with your car in 2019, now we’re expanding into new verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, boat). Why we’re hiring: Our next chapter is about accelerating growth – from 5M to 50M customers by 2030. This year alone, we launched 5 new products – home insurance, property tax, motorcycle insurance, car repair shop bids, and roadside assistance. Each of these new businesses comes with its own operational complexity, distinct customer pain points, and its own path to scale. As our business expands, we have a growing list of ideas but not enough people to execute them. This program exists to close that gap. We are looking for 2-3 Product Managers-in-Training to work directly with, and be mentored by, our Cofounder/CEO (2x YC founder), and work on building or scaling one of our new product verticals. You will be exposed to nearly every function at the company (i.e., product, growth, operations, finance, engineering, data), learn how to execute big-picture strategies and navigate the intricacies of a complex business. A successful graduate will likely go on to become a product leader or commercial leader (e.g. owning P&L) here or elsewhere. If you’re looking for an opportunity to greatly accelerate your career trajectory, we’d love to hear from you. If something is broken, you feel responsible for fixing it, even if it’s outside of your swim lane. - Tenacious: You are highly resilient. jobs.title: Strategic Fixer
jobs.description: ABOUT CLIPBOARD Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S. Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company https://www.ycombinator.com/topcompanies/ and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities. OVERVIEW Our largest customers run complex operations, and when something isn’t working, the problem rarely sits neatly within one team. A customer may be implementing a new product, dealing with a complicated integration, or facing an operational issue with no obvious owner or solution. That’s where you come in! We’re looking for a Strategic Fixer who wants exposure to a wide range of problems and is ready to own outcomes. You will take ambiguous problems, structure them, dig into the details, align senior stakeholders, and drive execution across teams that don’t report to you. This isn’t a role where you make a recommendation and hand it off. One week you might be diagnosing a failing payroll integration, the next coordinating an engineering fix, and the next working with a customer’s VP of Operations to get an implementation back on track. The problems might vary, but your job stays the same: figure it out, get the right people moving, and own the problem until it’s solved. This role opens doors to a range of growth paths across Clipboard! WHAT YOU'LL DO - Analyze operational data to spot trends and bottlenecks, and turn your findings into clear recommendations that guide business decisions. - Research and evaluate new tools, including AI, automation, and internal systems, and drive their adoption to make operations more effective. - Design processes, workflows, and operating procedures that improve efficiency, quality, and customer experience - Lead cross-functional projects and strategic initiatives from planning through execution, partnering with Operations, Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and other teams. The future of healthcare isn't just digital, it's automated. Come help us build it! You take ownership of critical operational topics end to end and contribute directly to Parallel’s growth. jobs.description: ABOUT JIGA Jiga is an AI-native manufacturing supplier that helps aerospace, defense and robotics companies get complex machined parts made by committed machine shops working as one. Teams at NASA, Collins Aerospace, Archer, Leidos and Siemens use Jiga for the parts their programs are waiting on. We're Series A, backed by Aleph and Y Combinator, and growing fast on a model with no bidding and no black box - the buyer sees, messages and audits the shop making their part. WHY THIS MATTERS AI is moving into the physical world. Every major program right now, in defense, aerospace and robotics, comes down to hardware, and getting the right part made is still one of the hardest, riskiest problems in manufacturing. A late or out-of-spec part can hold up a satellite launch or a drone program for months. The US has the shops to do this work. Thousands of small machine shops, many of them excellent, sit underutilized, because there's no way for a 15-person shop and a satellite program to work together without someone in the middle chasing quotes and revisions by hand. The common answers are a black box with a bidding war behind it, or build megafactories. Our bet is that the capacity already exists and the missing piece is the layer that orchestrates it. That's what Jiga is building: the AI infrastructure for the companies building the future to get the parts they need, and for the US to bring manufacturing back to the small shops that can do the work. WHAT YOU'LL DO BUILD THE PROCESS AND COACH TO IT - Turn how our best reps win an account into one process every rep runs - Call reviews and coaching SCALE THE TEAM - Hire the sales team on a proven profile OWN THE NUMBER - Revenue plan, quota and forecast - The operating cadence: pipeline reviews, per-rep metrics and the comp plan, with our growth lead on revops. SET THE GO-TO-MARKET - Who we sell to, who we don't, and how an account expands from a first order into a program. - Voice of the customer to product, marketing and supply chain, so what customers say shapes what we build and who we source. OUR CULTURE Remote-first. We don't count hours, we measure performance. We hate micromanagement and unproductive meetings. We play online games together, encourage hard questions, and fly everyone out once a year for a week-long offsite (Spain, Greece and Albania so far). YOU'RE A FIT IF YOU - Built a sales system once already, as the leader accountable for it, in a business where the sale depended on fulfillment people had to trust. You can draw the funnel you inherited, what you changed and what you learned. - Coached reps up. You can name a rep who went from bottom half to quota under you and what you changed in how they sell. - Think in systems. You see the sales motion as one machine with feedback loops and lags. You look for the one change that moves every number downstream, build mechanisms rather than ask for more effort. - Have strong opinions on hiring. How to spot a great rep, what the first 90 days look like, what you fire for. And probably two or three people who'd follow you. - Think big and thoughtful on the sequence. You have a picture of the $1B revenue org and the next actions to get there. THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF - You've only run sales where marketing built the pipeline and the product carried the sale. - Your last three roles were running established teams at $50M+ and you'd be inheriting a working machine. - You'd rather manage the cadence than write the process. HOW TO APPLY Tell us about the sales system you built, with numbers.

What you'll be doing - Manage the full sales cycle, selling to academic institutions and industry companies across the globe - Become an expert in BioRender’s features, benefits, and use cases - Consistently attain and exceed all revenue and booking targets within assigned territory or category - Organize, categorize, and prioritize sales leads in CRM — measure lead conversion and performance against quota - Develop and execute on strategic account expansion plans for named enterprise accounts in assigned territory - Partner with Marketing, Customer Success, Product and other internal teams to continue to improve and iterate on what’s required to succeed What you bring to the table - 3+ years of previous experience in full-cycle SaaS sales as an Account Executive - Experience selling highly technical products in SaaS environments - Bachelor’s degree in a life science discipline or prior life sciences experience (e.g. biology, biotechnology, biomedical engineering, biochemistry) a plus - History of consistently achieving or exceeding sales targets and have experience working on deals with multiple stakeholders - Strong communication skills and the ability to connect effectively with a range of stakeholders, including scientists, team project liaisons, and industry executives - Gritty and resourceful; you leverage tools and technology to sell strategically and efficiently - Strong ability to interpret feedback and apply coaching quickly What you can expect from our interview process - Introductory calls: We will set up a 30-minute phone call with one of our recruiters and/or our Sales Leaders, during which you’ll have the opportunity to share more about your experience and interests. As our engineering organization continues to grow, we are seeking Engineering Managers to lead teams that build the core product platform. You will oversee execution of the technical roadmap for core products and manage the team to deliver world-class industrial AI products. This is a hands-on leadership role with high visibility and significant impact on the future of our products and engineering organization. To be effective in this role, you should have a strong technical background and be comfortable diving deeply into technical details and understanding complex systems, while effectively managing a team of engineers to drive towards goals. ABOUT THE TEAM This team owns everything the customer sees and touches: from the frontend application that is the entire user interface of the product, to the backend business logic that runs the inspections behind it. The full stack of the user's experience, end to end. This team builds how an operator sets up an inspection, how a quality engineer reads the result, and how the interfaces work reliably in a 24/7 mission-critical manufacturing environment. Taipei is our product engineering hub and you will be working alongside embedded engineering teams and AI/ML teams. WHAT YOU WILL OWN The roadmap for your layer. Work with product and engineering leadership to turn company priorities into a sequenced plan your team can execute, and push back when the sequence does not hold up. Releases people can trust. Own the release process for your components: sprint cadence, branch and release structure, test gates in GitHub Actions, and the discipline that keeps a regression from reaching a customer's line. Performance and robustness as standing work. Memory behavior, startup time, long-run stability and graceful degradation. You will define what good looks like here and build the practices that hold it. The field loop. Talk to customers directly and turn what you learn into engineering priorities. jobs.title: Special Projects Lead - Category Expansion
jobs.description: CAN YOU HELP US FIX THE WORLD'S MOST BROKEN SUPPLY CHAIN? The fashion industry produces over 100 billion garments a year. 60% end up in landfill, not because people don't want these clothes, but because the supply chain for getting secondhand fashion from donation to resale is completely offline, manual and broken. Fleek is fixing this. Our mission is to make secondhand the first choice. We're building the infrastructure powering the global secondhand clothing trade, through a B2B marketplace and the AI systems digitising the supply chain behind it. Through Fleek, vintage stores, online resellers and retail buyers source graded secondhand inventory directly from wholesalers and rag houses across multiple countries. Our key enabler is FleekSort, an AI model fine-tuned on secondhand fashion that can grade, price and categorise items with just a photo. Turning what has historically been an opaque and manual trade into a structured, searchable and tradable global inventory layer. Since 2022, we've saved 9 million items from landfill while tripling in size year-on-year. We're backed by some of the world's best investors, including a16z, Y Combinator and HV Capital, alongside world-class angels who helped build Depop, Shopify, and Postmates. Today, we serve thousands of resellers and retailers across the UK, Europe and the US. With the secondhand fashion market projected to reach $350B by 2027, Fleek is building the AI-native operational and financial backbone for secondhand commerce globally. We're looking for people who want to build something that matters and move fast doing it. Sounds good? Keep reading. ABOUT THE ROLE We're hiring a Special Projects Lead to take Fleek's new category bets from thesis to proven economics. Each is a new business line that could add £5M+ in GMV, opening a new supply category or a new sourcing geography for the marketplace. Here's what makes these bets unusually winnable. Fleek already owns the demand. Most of the live bets sell to buyers who transact on Fleek today, so they're a supply-first test rather than a two-sided cold start. Your job on a new bet is to find and onboard the supply, sell it into demand that already exists and read the economics fast. Every bet runs through the same gates. If a bet misses its gates, you kill it with evidence and move to the next one. If it works and you're running it well, you don't have to hand it off. You scale into owning the category, with supply, acquisition and ops building out under you. Think of this seat as a venture builder inside Fleek. One thing this is not. We're not building a sales team or a sales culture, and this is not an AE or account manager role with a new title. You'll work directly with the founders and our commercial lead, close to the centre of the company. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Run bets through the gates: take each bet from market research to first suppliers to first GMV to a feasible-or-not call, with win metrics and kill metrics defined before you start. - Go where the supply is: get on planes. You'll visit suppliers, graders and rag houses in the markets your bets open up, because this trade is built face to face and the best stock never gets listed anywhere. - Sell supply into live demand: onboard brands, brokers, graders and wholesalers, then get Fleek's existing buyers transacting on the new inventory. The sell is fast, informal and relationship-led, over WhatsApp and Instagram as often as in a boardroom. - Make the kill calls: hold a clear view of unit economics and the competitive landscape on every bet. Double down or cut on evidence, not attachment. - Be the ops function, for now: work out importer-of-record structures, duties, freight cost and last mile for each new flow. - Ride the AI infrastructure: our acquisition team has spent months building the agentic outreach and enrichment engine. You'll plug your bets into it and extend it, rather than building from a blank page or adding headcount. - Learn the actual trade: how stock

jobs.title: Senior CRM Executive
jobs.description: Ambition has no passport. That belief is why LemFi https://lemfi.com/en-gb/careers exists. We started with remittances: the money people send home to the people they love. Now we run multi-currency accounts, Savings, eSIMs and Credit. Because staying connected to home and building somewhere new are not two separate things. They never were. ABOUT THE ROLE Every product launch, promo and market entry at LemFi reaches customers through a campaign. As Senior CRM Executive, you'll build and ship them: email, push, in-app and SMS, across remittance, credit, savings and whatever we launch next. You take a brief and turn it into a live, tested, correctly targeted send - then tell us what it did. You'll report to the Senior CRM Manager for Campaigns and work daily with Growth Managers, Product Marketing, Design and Compliance. This is a hands-on role with a high volume of sends and a high bar for getting each one right, because a wrong rate, a broken link or the wrong segment lands in a customer's pocket. Do it well and you'll be the person the rest of the business trusts to get their message out. WHAT YOU'LL BUILD AND OWN - Build and launch campaigns end to end in our marketing automation platform: segments, content, scheduling and send. - Turn campaign requests from across the business into clear builds, and push back when a brief doesn't hold up. - QA every send before it goes: targeting, personalisation, links, localisation and compliance sign-off. - Run A/B tests on subject lines, timing, offers and channels, and feed what wins into the next campaign. - Keep the campaign calendar honest so customers aren't hit by five messages in one day. - Report on every campaign in numbers the team can act on: who received it, who converted, what it was worth. - Spot what's repetitive in your own work and template or automate it. YOUR EXPERIENCE - 1-3 years in CRM, email marketing or lifecycle, ideally in fintech, e-commerce or another high-frequency consumer product. - Hands-on with a marketing automation platform (Customer.io http://Customer.io, Braze, Iterable or similar) - you build the campaign yourself. - Working knowledge of Liquid and HTML for personalised, dynamic content. - An eye for detail that catches the wrong segment or the broken link before the customer does. - Comfortable pulling your own numbers, with basic SQL or a BI tool such as Tableau, Looker, Amplitude or Mixpanel. - Bias to ship: you'd rather launch, measure and iterate than polish a brief. - Comfortable using AI tools to speed up copy variants, translations and QA checks. NICE TO HAVE - Lived experience or deep empathy with the life of our users - the millions who move countries to build something better. - Language skills in Italian, Portuguese, German, Mandarin, Wolof or Swahili. - Experience running campaigns in a regulated or compliance-sensitive comms environment. WHY JOIN LEMFI? Your work here puts money back into families' pockets. That's the reward, and the weight of it. You'll take on some of the hardest problems in finance alongside people who do their best work when the stakes are real. We move fast and we expect a lot, because our customers can't afford for us to do otherwise. In return you get room to own real problems, global impact you can see, and a team that won't slow you down. Bring grit and ownership and there's a place for them here. Ambition belongs here, come and show us yours. Junction is building the infrastructure layer for diagnostic healthcare, making patient data accessible, actionable, and automated across labs and devices. Our mission is simple but ambitious: use health data to unlock unprecedented insight into human health and disease. If you're passionate about how technology can supercharge healthcare, you’ll fit right in. Backed by Creandum, Point Nine, 20VC, YC, and leading angels, we’re working to solve one of the biggest challenges of our time: making healthcare personalized, proactive, and affordable. We’re already connecting millions and scaling fast. Short on time? TL;DR - You: Can define what should be measured, how it should be modeled, and how those insights should shape product and company decisions. - Ownership: You’ll own Junction’s highest-leverage statistical, modeling, and evaluation work across diagnostics, clinical workflows, and AI-enabled product development. - Scope: This is not a pure IC modeling role and not a reporting role. jobs.title: Data Scientist, Lab & Protein Data
jobs.description: Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments. We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world. We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today. Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development. We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation. ABOUT THE ROLE You'll build out the data science layer of Adaptyv's foundry — the work that turns tens of thousands of raw, messy experimental readouts into clean, trustworthy, structured data that our customers, our models, and our own scientists can rely on. Binding (BLI/SPR), developability, biophysical, and functional assays all produce data at scale; your job is to make that data correct, comparable, and useful. This sits at the intersection of three things: data quality (is this number real, or an artifact?), bioinformatics (linking experimental results back to sequence, structure, and protein design), and dataset building (turning foundry output into the kind of high-quality, benchmarkable data that frontier AI labs actually want). You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with the lab scientists who run the assays, the software team who own the pipelines, and the customers who train models on what we produce. This is a hands-on build role, not a management one. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Own the scientific logic of data quality across the foundry: define what "good data" looks like for each assay type — expected signal ranges, control thresholds, failure modes, edge cases — and turn it into automated checks. - Build anomaly detection and QC models that catch bad data the eye would miss: assay drift, instrument variability, plate effects, false passes and false fails — and distinguish real signal from noise statistically. - Work with the software and ML teams to specify, review, and improve the automated data pipelines that process instrument outputs, feeding back precise requirements for what to flag, auto-reject, or route to human review. - Connect experimental results back to the protein side — sequence, structure, and design — so wet-lab data and computational models reinforce each other. - Turn foundry output into structured, documented, benchmark-grade datasets that are a genuine asset for our customers and for training and evaluating protein-design models. - Apply real statistical rigor to multi-condition data at scale — thousands of samples across hundreds of simultaneous experiments — and make the results interpretable and comparable across runs. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Strong data science / bioinformatics background — you're fluent in Python (pandas, numpy, the scientific stack) and comfortable owning messy, real-world experimental data end to end. - Genuine biology grounding — you understand proteins, assays, and sequence/structure/function well enough to know what the data means, not just how to process it. You don't need to be a bench scientist, but you can't be biology-blind. - Statistical maturity — process control, anomaly detection, handling variability and batch effects; you can tell drift from noise and defend the call. - Prolific builder

jobs.description: ABOUT BITSTACK It all started with an idea in 2021. Initially built to democratize Bitcoin in France, Bitstack has gone from a simple product that invests spare change in bitcoin, to a crypto-native bank bringing a better way to save, spend, and grow money to our 300K+ users. We want to rebuild finance from the ground up to empower people to achieve financial freedom by participating in a more open and inclusive financial system. We’re a small, ambitious team of operators. We believe in moving fast, sweating the details, and creating products people truly love. At Bitstack, you’ll have the opportunity to shape not just our products, but the culture and practices of our entire organization. Bitstack is backed by YC, leading VCs like 13books Capital, Stillmark, Serena, and many more. We are building a product our users love and we are just getting started! The Role Bitstack is a crypto-asset service provider authorised under the MiCA Regulation. As such, we are subject to strict requirements relating to anti-money laundering (AML), counter-terrorist financing (CTF) and fraud prevention. As part of the Compliance team, you will contribute to the day-to-day implementation of our compliance framework. You will review alerts and customer cases across three key areas: transaction monitoring, screening and KYC. What You'll Be Doing 1. Transaction Monitoring (Fiat & Crypto) - Analyse and investigate transaction monitoring alerts across euro payment flows (card payments and SEPA transfers) and crypto flows (on-chain deposits and withdrawals). - Examine transaction patterns, counterparties and wallet exposure to assess each alert and determine whether it is a false positive or should be escalated. - Detect fraudulent activity, including payment fraud, account takeovers and scams targeting our users. - Document your findings and, where appropriate, prepare the supporting information for a suspicious activity report to TRACFIN, the French financial intelligence unit. - Contribute to improving detection scenarios and monitoring alert metrics. 2. Screening: PEPs, Sanctions & Adverse Media - Review screening alerts and determine whether a match is genuine or a false positive. - Implement enhanced due diligence measures for politically exposed persons (PEPs), including checks on the source of funds and source of wealth. - Escalate confirmed matches against sanctions lists or adverse media findings in accordance with internal procedures. 3. KYC (Know Your Customer) - Review and validate customer supporting documents, including proof of identity, proof of address, proof of income, source of funds and source of wealth. - Detect identity theft attempts and forged documents. - Assess consistency between the customer's profile, declared information and observed activity. - Request additional documentation and follow up on cases through to their final decision. You will also contribute to updating internal procedures and monitoring emerging fraud and money laundering typologies within the crypto ecosystem. You will gain hands-on experience with an AML/CFT framework at a regulated crypto-asset service provider. You will learn how alerts are handled from initial detection through to the final decision, how a risk-based approach is applied, how blockchain analytics tools are used, and how the Compliance team collaborates with Product, Operations and Customer Support. jobs.title: Senior Applied Data Scientist
jobs.description: A little bit about us: We are Belvo, an open finance API platform with the bold vision of democratizing access to financial services in Latin America. We enable any financial innovator to access and interpret financial data, as well as initiate payments from their end-users accounts. We’re turning the messy complexities of the Latin American financial ecosystem into a modern set of tools to access and interpret data and move money in a seamless and secure way. We’re a highly-technical, passionate, and driven team. We are more than 90 people and our team currently represents 20 nationalities. We have offices in São Paulo and Mexico City – while a large portion of us work remotely. We are tackling a very stimulating problem: connecting fintech innovators with legacy financial infrastructure. We strive to go beyond the limits of what is possible today and to do so in an elegant and developer-first way. Since starting our adventure in May 2019, we have raised $71m from the leading VC investors globally. You can read more about our company here https://belvo.com/about/ and about our team and culture here https://belvo.com/careers/. Also, head to our blog https://belvo.com/blog/ for more news about what we’re building and how we work https://belvo.com/blog/category/working-belvo/. About the team: - We work in cross-functional, autonomous teams. We follow continuous delivery best practices executed on top of a modern technology stack. - Our products are built for developers, by developers. Technological excellence is at the heart of what we do. - We are pragmatic and customer-focused. We strive to find the right set of trade-offs in order to validate our hypothesis as early as possible, iterating on our products based on customer feedback. - We communicate transparently. We do weekly all-hands where we get together to discuss company performance and goals. - While we are global and remote-friendly, we also operate from our vibrant offices in CDMX and Sao Paulo. To accommodate the various time zones in which we are based, we ensure we’re always synced up for at least 3 hours per day. - Also, we are backed by some of the leading investors in Silicon Valley and Latin America, including Founders Fund, Kaszek Ventures, and YCombinator. The challenge The Intelligence Squad is Belvo's AI enabler team. One part of the squad builds the platforms and patterns that let every team at Belvo ship AI. This role sits in the other part: turning the financial data and payments we aggregate across Latin America into models that make real decisions, who looks creditworthy, which transaction is fraudulent, what category a payment belongs to, whether an income statement checks out. That data drives real financial outcomes for the people and businesses on the other end, so the bar for rigor is high. You'll be the data science reference in the squad. We're not hiring someone to execute a modeling backlog someone else wrote. We want someone who decides which problems are worth modeling, defines how we know a model is good enough, and raises the data science bar for everyone they work with. You'll be deep enough in statistics and ML to defend a modeling choice to anyone, whether this is a set of rules to simplify a problem or a complex model that you build. You'll be close enough to the business to turn a commercial problem into a modeling roadmap and a business case. And you'll be a strong enough engineer to take your models from notebook to production and own them there. By storing electricity thermochemically, the system delivers a continuous stream of combustion-free, high-temperature air at up to 1,200°C. Tempo is backed by leading climate and energy investors, including Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Khosla Ventures, and Prelude Ventures. For more information, visit www.tempoenergy.com . Hands-on design, design for manufacturability (DFM), and fabrication experience. Experience with common fabrication methods and tools (welder, router, mill, lathe, hand tools, etc.). Data acquisition and instrumentation experience (thermocouples, pressure sensors, electrical sensors, flow sensors, oxygen sensors, etc…). Demonstrated ability to drive projects to completion. jobs.title: First RevOps
jobs.description: At Parallel, we build AI agents that help healthcare organizations automate their administrative processes and unlock additional revenue, starting with medical coding. Today, up to 25% of healthcare spending is lost to manual, repetitive administrative tasks. Legacy software hasn't helped: it has made work slower, more complex and more frustrating for care teams. We believe AI agents can change this. Our technology combines large language models with system-level automation to do real work inside existing hospital tools. No integration, no disruption. Our first agent automates coding and frees up time for medical teams to focus on patients. We launched in 2024 and already have 800+ customers and a team of 30+ people. We are backed by top-tier investors (Index Ventures, Y Combinator, Hexa, Frst, Kima Ventures, Better Angle and the CEO of Mistral AI), and this is just the beginning. The future of healthcare isn't just digital, it's automated. Come help us build it! CONTEXT Our coding agent is live in 70 hospitals across France. In March, we raised $20M from Index Ventures to push it further and build what comes next: billing, admissions, patient records. The next six months are going to move fast. Nobody owns this problem yet, it will be yours. YOUR MISSION Make sure Parallel can double without drowning in manual work. Attio, our CRM, will be your main tool, and you'll run it end to end. You'll also sit with each team, see what they still do by hand, and automate it yourself. jobs.title: Senior Product Security Engineer (USA Only, 100% Remote)
jobs.description: About Us Since 2013, we’ve been building a CRM that gets out of your way and helps your team sell more, faster. Now we’re building AI into every part of it, so Close does the busywork and your team does the selling. No manual data entry, no 10-click workflows. Just communication-first, AI-powered sales software designed to help you succeed and scale. We're bootstrapped and profitable which means we answer to our customers and play by our rules. We're proud of our 130-person, 100% remote team, focused on building Close so that no small, scaling business fails because it can't figure out sales. ABOUT THE ROLE Close is a CRM built around the communication tools sales teams use every day: email, calling, SMS, workflows, reporting, and AI. Underneath that product is a broad technical surface — Python services and a large application backend, a TypeScript and React frontend, public APIs, Docker and Kubernetes, AWS infrastructure, and integrations with providers that handle sensitive customer data. Security work happens across it all today, but the ownership is spread across Engineering, Infrastructure, and Security & Trust. We’re hiring our first dedicated Product Security Engineer to make that work systematic. You’ll report to the Backend Platform team manager within EPD (Engineering, Product, and Design), while working across the entire product and infrastructure surface. You’ll find vulnerabilities, determine which findings matter most, and drive them through remediation. Often you’ll fix the problem yourself. Other times you’ll give the owning team a clear reproduction, a practical path forward, and enough context to prioritize correctly. You’ll analyze code, build proof-of-concepts, test running applications, tune or replace noisy tools, and automate the repetitive parts of vulnerability management. This is not a role where you forward scanner alerts and call the queue managed. Product and application security will be your responsibility. You’ll partner closely with our Infrastructure team on cloud security, access, and secrets, and with our Security & Trust Lead on GRC Engineering https://grc.engineering/, compliance (SOC 2) goals, audits, and corporate security. This role is a new one at Close. You’ll have significant room to decide where better tooling, clearer ownership, and a small amount of code can reduce the most risk. OUR STACK Our backend is primarily Python, with Flask and FastAPI services and TaskTiger https://github.com/closeio/tasktiger and Temporal handling much of our asynchronous work. We expose REST https://developer.close.com/ and GraphQL APIs and store data in MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, and Redis. Our frontend is a large single-page TypeScript application built primarily with React. We bundle with Vite, target modern browsers, and test with Vitest, React Testing Library, Playwright, and Chromatic. The product updates in near real time and uses technologies including WebSockets and WebRTC. Our mobile application is built with React Native. We build and test Docker images in CI/CD and continuously deploy them to Kubernetes on AWS. Our infrastructure uses managed services including EKS, MSK, and ElastiCache, alongside services running on EC2. Terraform and Ansible automate much of the underlying infrastructure, and our containerized local development environment lets engineers run the full system on their own machines. For this role, our stack extends beyond simply backend or frontend: browser behavior, frontend state, API authorization, asynchronous processing, data access, third-party integrations, containers, and cloud configuration can all be part of the same attack path. We love open sourcing our code and ideas on our GitHub https://github.com/closeio and on The Making of Close https://making.close.com/, our behind-the-scenes Product & Engineering blog. Check out our open source projects like SocketShark https://github.com/closeio/socketshark, TaskTiger https://github.com/closeio/tasktiger, LimitL

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer
jobs.description: ABOUT APTIBLE Large language models are transforming software engineering — developers can now go from idea to code faster than ever. But that just shifts complexity downstream: deployment, observability, cost, security, reliability — all of that has to scale too, and LLMs don't yet solve the problem. That's where Aptible comes in. Since 2014, our cloud delivery platform has been automating security, compliance and reliability for engineering teams whose apps handle the most sensitive data, in the most highly regulated industries. The need for a platform like Aptible has never been greater. If you're passionate about cloud infrastructure and ensuring DevOps evolves to meet the pressure of AI-assisted development — and you're excited to join a small and highly talented team — we’d love to hear from you. NEW! Aptible is part of Opti9 Technologies, a cloud solutions provider specializing in managed cloud, security, disaster recovery, and compliance. Joining forces with Opti9 gives Aptible the resources to invest more aggressively in the platform — expanding what we can deliver to the engineering teams who depend on it. OUR COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION We see great value in bringing together a team with different perspectives, educational backgrounds, and life experiences, and we prioritize diversity within our team. We encourage people from underrepresented backgrounds to apply. ABOUT THIS ROLE OVERVIEW In this role, you'll lead on projects that improve defense and hardening for a platform that regulated companies build their businesses on. This is a hand-on engineering role where you'll architect and build secure-by-default infrastructure, run our vulnerability management and pentesting programs, and lead incident response when things go wrong. This role reports to the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), but will work day-to-day as a member of our Platform Engineering team, and in close collaboration all engineers at Aptible. WHAT YOU'LL DO Engineering - Architect and ship projects that make a meaningful improvements to our security posture and the security posture of our customers. These improvements span the full stack, from AWS and Docker to CloudFormation, Terraform, Ansible, Ruby, Go, Python, and TypeScript. - Leverage cutting-edge AI models and third-party tools, or build your own from scratch, to level up our security game. - Own our vulnerability management and pentesting programs end to end, finding the best ways to automate vulnerability detection and mitigation. - Join the on-call rotation as a first responder for security events, and ensure we mitigate with lasting fixes so the same issue never wakes anyone up twice. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR General Experience - 5+ years of experience in engineering, with a track record of owning security-critical systems in production. - Hands on experience working on projects related to security and/or compliance. Experience with HITRUST is a plus. - You communicate extremely well. You favor communication that is clear, concise, and proactive. - Prior experience working on developer tools or platform engineering experience is a plus. Technical Expertise - You have strong engineering fundamentals and coding ability, with comfort working across the full stack on a large distributed system. - You're a thoughtful developer in at least one mainstream language, are comfortable picking up new languages or working in unfamiliar codebases. - You have hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure security (AWS strongly preferred). - You have experience leading or heavily participating in incident response. Organizational Strength - You're organized enough to run the technical portion of a compliance recertification as a project - coordinating with other engineers to collect and submit evidence by hard deadlines - without that becoming your whole job. - You don't let ambiguity or bumps in the road stop you.
