Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Product, Finance, and Legal to launch joint offerings and ensure operational alignment. Track partnership performance, including pipeline, bookings, revenue, referrals, engagement, and return on investment. Monitor HCM market trends, competitive activity, and partner priorities to refine strategy and uncover new growth opportunities. What You will Bring: 5+ years of demonstrated success in strategic alliances, partner management, channel sales, or enterprise business development within the B2B SaaS industry. Ability to travel - 30% travel required Direct experience working for, with, or alongside UKG and/or Dayforce is strongly preferred (familiarity with their partner programs, sales motions, integration architectures, and customer base is highly valued). Consistent history of delivering against revenue targets, driving qualified pipeline, and scaling successful co-sell or reseller programs. Strong proficiency in value-based selling, territory planning, pipeline qualification, contract negotiation, and executive-level pitching. Demonstrated ability to motivate and collaborate with internal direct sales reps and partner sales forces to co-sell and advance opportunities through the funnel. Ability to translate complex software workflows, APIs, and product capabilities into clear, compelling joint value propositions for buyers and sellers alike. Solid analytical capabilities to evaluate partnership health, track metrics in CRM/PRM systems (e.g., Salesforce, Crossbeam), and make data-backed decisions. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

jobs.title: Manager, Commercial Strategy and Finance (New York)
jobs.description: About Us Powered by one of the largest global newsrooms in sports media, The Athletic brings sports fans the most comprehensive stories about the teams, sports and athletes they love. The Athletic’s newsroom of 500+ full-time staff delivers in-depth coverage of hundreds of professional and college teams across more than 47 North American markets and all 20 football clubs in the English Premier League, as well as many Championship clubs. About the Role The Athletic is looking for a Manager, Commercial Strategy and Finance to serve as the primary architect and steward of our most complex and high-value commercial initiatives and partnerships. This is a high-visibility role that sits at the intersection of business development, strategy, deal-making, and operational rigor; it is a hybrid role based in New York City, reporting into a Vice President of Advertising Finance. We are looking for a "dual-threat" professional: someone who has a deep reverence for analytical rigor, paired with a commercially-minded approach that helps guide projects and deals to success. You will be the quantitative engine driving our commercial strategy; not just evaluating ideas before launch and deals before they are signed; but rigorously tracking performance once they are live. This is a hybrid role and will require 3 days / week in office for candidates in the greater New York City Metropolitan area. Responsibilities : Commercial planning and analysis: You will translate dense financial data and analysis into high-impact visual narratives for discussions with The Athletic’s leadership team. You'll articulate the "why" behind every major investment. Modeling and evaluation: Build clean, flexible financial models to value complex and integrated deals and commercial initiatives across licensing and advertising, as well as other revenue streams. Deal construction: Analyze and aid in negotiation of deal mechanics, focusing on minimum guarantees (MGs), revenue shares, and recoupment schedules. You will partner closely with Legal and Accounting to ensure term sheets translate into sound financial realities. Post-close performance tracking: Own the "full-lifecycle" of the deal. Once a partnership is live, you are on the hook for tracking actuals vs. benchmarks, managing P&L impact, and providing the FP&A oversight needed to course-correct or double-down. Forecasting and variance analysis: Integrate live deal performance into our broader rolling forecasts, explaining variances to leadership and identifying trends in audience monetization and rights costs. Requirements : 5+ years of experience in corporate development, strategic finance, consulting or investment banking. Analytically rigorous individual with experience performing high stakes evaluation of potential deals, ideally including content licensing. Deep understanding of the leverage points in a negotiation; can anticipate how a legal clause might impact a financial outcome. Someone who understands the value of accuracy; whether it's a pre-deal valuation or a post-deal performance report, you own the numbers from start to finish. Genuinely motivated by The Athletic’s mission; you understand the value of premium sports journalism and the gravity of the shifting media landscape. Expert-level financial modeling. Strong executive presentation development skills. Deep understanding of commercial deal terms, negotiations, and deal processes. Experience with key FP&A processes (budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis). BS in Finance/Economics, MBA a plus.

jobs.description: The Role: We're looking for a Manufacturing Lead to own how we make our Systems & Consumables - and to make sure we can do it reliably, quickly, at scale, to the standard our customers and regulators require. Our product offering intersects two different tech stacks: electromechanical automation systems packed with custom robotics, and sterile fluidic plastic consumables made to GMP standards. You'll contribute to the strategic direction for manufacturing while staying close enough to the floor to fix problems yourself when it matters. You'll be working directly with the Head of Engineering and with leadership, sales, finance, and planning to make sure manufacturing keeps pace with an ambitious commercial roadmap. Experience across both electromechanical assembly and sterile / GMP plastics manufacturing is a strong differentiator. What you'll be doing: Own and continuously improve manufacture of our automation systems/consumables - growing volume while driving up yield/quality and driving down cost/lead time. Track and actively drive down COGS, model unit economics, develop and implement large capex/opex strategies. Bring new products into stable manufacture smoothly and on schedule. Build backend services that communicate with our hardware systems and learn about data integrity throughout the cell manufacturing process. Collaborate across disciplines with hardware engineers, biologists, and commercial teams to build reliable and effective systems in record time. Learn and contribute to our testing methods to help us deliver quality software at speed. Learn and contribute to architecture and infrastructure, system performance, and interesting distributed system challenges. Write code that you can immediately see the real-world impact: testing on our prototype machines in our own lab. Up-skill in domains outside software engineering, from donning a lab coat and be trained on the nuances of stem cells, to the basics of fluid mechanics. Be given a lot of autonomy, responsibility, and ownership of product problems and the technical solutions you design and deliver to address customer needs. What We're Looking For (depending on experience level): Are early in your software career and want to join an environment that gives you the chance to grow quickly Have demonstrated technical promise so far in your studies or work Want to work on difficult technical challenges in a field that will define the biggest scientific advancement this century Self-starter attitude with a drive for producing quality work. Care and compassion for customers and colleagues. Experience with full-stack web development using TypeScript or other typed languages. Experience with modern frontend frameworks (React preferred). Experience with backend development and API design (Node.js preferred). Experience working with databases (PostgreSQL and Prisma or similar ORM experience ideal). Our technologies: Frontend (Netlify): React, TypeScript, GraphQL, Storybook Backend (AWS & Heroku): NodeJS, TypeScript, GraphQL, MQTT, PostgreSQL, Python, Pulumi IaC Physical Device (on-premise): NodeJS, Typescript, FastAPI, Python

jobs.title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
jobs.description: We are looking to hire an Enterprise Customer Success Manager looking to join an early yet executive CS team and have an impact on a category-defining company, backed by some of the best investors in Silicon Valley. CS Managers at Emi are the CEOs of our Portfolio Partners, not only managing relationship with our customer’s leadership team, but leading the strategy in order to have a larger impact in each account. About the Customer Success Team At Emi we are focused on solving real problems for our clients and for our candidates, which is why we are a customer-focused company. Our customer success team is responsible of leading the relationship with our clients and ensuring they obtain the best results from our projects together. Our team is composed of people with strong client relationship skills who are also extremely data-driven and capable of pivoting between multiple internal teams in terms of implementation, sales, product, and tech in order to drive results. About Us At Emi Labs (YC '19) we are on a mission to increase frontline workers' access to professional opportunities by building the infrastructure for Frontline Workers (check our manifesto online). As our first step, we are transforming the high-volume recruiting process of Frontline Workers to make it as simple, human, and fair as possible for both Candidates and Recruiters. Our product is a SaaS recruitment platform powered by AI that helps companies engage with candidates via text to drive faster and more efficient hiring processes. We are growing fast, well funded, and obsessed with making our mission a reality. Responsibilities: Build a long term, value based relationship with the leadership team and champions of our clients (CHROs, VP of Talent) Being the trusted partner for the customer on use-case and product functionality Deliver and communicate ROI for our clients throughout the customer lifecycle in Monthly and Quarterly Business Reviews (MBRs / QBRs) Be the voice of the customer in Emi, providing insights to work side-by-side with our product and tech teams Identify potential account growth (upsells) and help execute them to guarantee we’re adding more value in our clients What we're looking for in Candidates: +3 years of work experience managing relationships with enterprise accounts - Management Consulting, Customer Success, Account Management, Business Development, is a plus. Ability to create structure in ambiguous situations and design effective processes Strategic and analytical mentality Executive presence and communication abilities Strong leadership skills Experience working with cross-functional teams (e.g. Sales, Product, Marketing, Services) Thrives working in a growing environment, with the uncertainty and chaos of an early stage startup Fluent English Speaker, native is a plus What we offer: 🧑🏽‍💻 Flexible remote-first work culture . We work towards goals* 📈 Stock Options: Stock Options Package as part of your compensation package. 🏖️ Vacations: 3-weeks of vacation 🧑‍🎄 Holiday season: Week off between Christmas and New Years' eve 🩺 Health coverage : Up to $1500 per year for local health insurance coverage 💆 Physical Wellness program: we have partnered up with Gympass, a wellbeing platform that offers the best coverage of top gyms, studios, and activities for you to choose from 🇺🇸 English Lessons: Improve your English skills with our in-company teachers 📚 Internal library: Get all the free books - digital, physical - you like, anytime

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description: About Us You rarely get the chance to change an entire industry. But that's the position we find ourselves in. Join us, and you’ll unleash scientists, accelerate their research and help get cures to patients sooner. We’ve developed machines to fully automate human cell production - the most manual process in Biotech. Cells are used to discover and develop new drugs, and now they're being used to treat cancer too. Mytos will impact cure development across the board. We're live in multibillion dollar biotechs on both coasts of the US, and just raised $19m to expand into the market faster, and accelerate our development! We’ve assembled a world-class team to take on this challenge, with ex-Dyson engineers and Nature-published scientists working hand-in-hand. You can learn more about your potential Mytos teammates here: Team Mytos is backed by Y Combinator, the most successful startup program in the world which produced companies such as AirBnb, Dropbox, and Ginkgo Bioworks. The Role This is an opportunity to redefine how the future of the biotech lab works. As the founding member of the Design team, you will be responsible for all aspects of Design at Mytos: from research, to concepting, to testing, to pixel-perfect UI. You’ll also define the design systems used across the whole company. Aside from occasional hardware interactions, the entire surface area of our product is in software - ranging from setting up experiments, managing cell batches in real-time, and analysing data. What you’ll be doing: Working with the founders + product teams to lead our design process from start to finish: from research, to concepting, to testing, to pixel-perfect UI Solving complex problems using customer-centric, validated and delightful product design Spending time with our internal lab biologists, to understand how biologists think Defining interaction models, task flows and screen designs. Defining our design systems, so others in the company or externals can create assets that are cohesive Taking part in discovery, workshop and co-design sessions with customers and colleagues. Who you are: You want an environment where you have high autonomy and decision-making agency to influence the direction Broad set of design skills across all aspects: from research, to human-centred design, to prototyping and visualisation You're curious and learn new areas fast A master of your toolkit - Figma (Our main tool), and your other preferred design and graphics tools Mastered the range of qualitative and quantitative research methods and when to apply them to validate your design Nice to have: Have been the first designer at a startup in the past Ability to code: we welcome designers polishing the front-end in production / contributing to the codebase A background in Biology or another science Salary and Benefits: Competitive salary with stock options Lunch covered daily Collaborative team environment with very high potential to learn new skills 24 days holiday (excluding bank holidays) Pension Awesome colleagues and an office in the Imperial College Innovation hub in White City, where you’ll be based.
